text:
```yaml
name: Govulncheck Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0' # Weekly at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  govulncheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Pin golang/govulncheck-action
        run: echo "::set-env name=GOVULNCHECK_ACTION_REF::refs/tags/v0.3.0"

      - name: Run govulncheck
        uses: golang/govulncheck-action@${{ env.GOVULNCHECK_ACTION_REF }}
        with:
          working-directory: .
```
